Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

' basResetFixture
' ----------------
' Wipes and reseeds the transactional tables in HomeHealthCare.accdb to a
' known UAT starting state. See docs/uat-seed-design.md for the contract.
'
' Usage (from the Access Immediate Window):
'
'     ResetForUAT
'
' Prerequisite: the BeforeChange data macro on tblClientServicePlan must
' preserve an explicit Status="Cancelled" (see docs/uat-seed-design.md §0).
' Without that fix, the one cancelled plan in the seed will be auto-rewritten
' to Pending and the verification block at the end of ResetForUAT will warn.

Private Const APPR_FY24 As Date = #9/15/2024#
Private Const APPR_FY25 As Date = #8/20/2025#
Private Const SUPERVISOR As String = "Sandra Supervisor"

' --------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Public entry point
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------

Public Sub ResetForUAT()
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim t0 As Double
    Dim step As String

    On Error GoTo eh
    Set db = CurrentDb
    t0 = Timer

    Debug.Print String(60, "-")
    Debug.Print "ResetForUAT starting at " & Format(Now, "hh:nn:ss")

    step = "DeleteTransactionalTables"
    DeleteTransactionalTables db

    ' Note: AutoNumber seeds are NOT reset. Jet rejects
    ' ALTER COLUMN ... COUNTER on PKs that participate in any Relation,
    ' which describes every transactional PK in this schema. The seed
    ' still produces stable explicit PKs (1..N) for fixture rows; only
    ' newly-added-during-UAT rows get whatever the historical counter
    ' is at, which is harmless for testing.

    step = "EnsureFiscalYears"
    EnsureFiscalYears db

    step = "SeedServices"
    SeedServices db
    step = "SeedServiceRateLimits"
    SeedServiceRateLimits db
    step = "SeedProviders"
    SeedProviders db
    step = "SeedProviderServiceCatalog"
    SeedProviderServiceCatalog db
    step = "SeedClients"
    SeedClients db
    step = "SeedClientBudgets"
    SeedClientBudgets db
    step = "SeedClientServiceNeeds"
    SeedClientServiceNeeds db
    step = "SeedClientServicePlans"
    SeedClientServicePlans db

    step = "Verify"
    Verify db

    Debug.Print "ResetForUAT done in " & Format(Timer - t0, "0.0") & "s"
    Debug.Print String(60, "-")

    MsgBox "UAT seed complete (" & Format(Timer - t0, "0.0") & "s)." & vbCrLf & _
           "See Immediate Window for row counts.", vbInformation, "ResetForUAT"
    Exit Sub

eh:
    Debug.Print "ResetForUAT FAILED at step: " & step
    Debug.Print "  Error " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description
    MsgBox "ResetForUAT failed at step '" & step & "':" & vbCrLf & _
           Err.Number & " - " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "ResetForUAT"
End Sub

' --------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Phase 1 - delete transactional rows in reverse-FK order
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub DeleteTransactionalTables(ByVal db As DAO.Database)
    Debug.Print "  Deleting transactional rows..."
    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblClientServicePlan", dbFailOnError
    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblClientServiceNeeds", dbFailOnError
    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblClientBudgets", dbFailOnError
    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblProviderServiceCatalog", dbFailOnError
    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblServiceRateLimits", dbFailOnError
    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblClients", dbFailOnError
    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblProviders", dbFailOnError
    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblServices", dbFailOnError
End Sub

' --------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Phase 2 - UPSERT fiscal years (idempotent)
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub EnsureFiscalYears(ByVal db As DAO.Database)
    Debug.Print "  Ensuring fiscal year rows..."
    UpsertFiscalYear db, 2024, #7/1/2024#, #6/30/2025#, False
    UpsertFiscalYear db, 2025, #7/1/2025#, #6/30/2026#, True
    UpsertFiscalYear db, 2026, #7/1/2026#, #6/30/2027#, False
End Sub

Private Sub UpsertFiscalYear(ByVal db As DAO.Database, _
                              ByVal fy As Integer, _
                              ByVal startDt As Date, _
                              ByVal endDt As Date, _
                              ByVal isCurrent As Boolean)
    Dim n As Long
    n = DCount("*", "tlkpFiscalYears", "FiscalYear=" & fy)
    If n > 0 Then
        db.Execute "UPDATE tlkpFiscalYears SET StartDate=" & DateLit(startDt) & _
                   ", EndDate=" & DateLit(endDt) & _
                   ", IsCurrent=" & BoolLit(isCurrent) & _
                   " WHERE FiscalYear=" & fy, dbFailOnError
    Else
        db.Execute "INSERT INTO tlkpFiscalYears (FiscalYear, StartDate, EndDate, IsCurrent) VALUES (" & _
                   fy & ", " & DateLit(startDt) & ", " & DateLit(endDt) & ", " & _
                   BoolLit(isCurrent) & ")", dbFailOnError
    End If
End Sub

' --------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Phase 3h - Client service plans (52 rows)
' WeeklyCost and AnnualEstCost are derived by the BeforeChange data macro
' from RatePerHour x HoursPerWeek (x52 for annual). Status is derived from
' ApprovalDate Is Not Null (Approved) vs Null (Pending), EXCEPT for the one
' Cancelled plan which requires the macro fix in design doc section 0.
'
' Per-client+FY annualized totals are designed so all approved plans fit
' within budget. The Daniel/FY25 pending plan is the deliberate exception:
' approving it would push over budget by ~$160 and trip dmValidateBudgetOnApproval.
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub InsPlanApproved(ByVal db As DAO.Database, _
                            ByVal id As Long, ByVal needId As Long, _
                            ByVal catId As Long, ByVal fy As Integer, _
                            ByVal Hours As Double)
    Dim apprDt As Date
    apprDt = IIf(fy = 2024, APPR_FY24, APPR_FY25)
    db.Execute "INSERT INTO tblClientServicePlan (ClientServicePlanID, ClientServiceNeedID, " & _
               "ProviderServiceCatalogID, FiscalYear, HoursPerWeek, ApprovalDate, ApprovedBy) VALUES (" & _
               id & ", " & needId & ", " & catId & ", " & fy & ", " & Hours & ", " & _
               DateLit(apprDt) & ", " & SqlStr(SUPERVISOR) & ")", dbFailOnError
End Sub

Private Sub InsPlanPending(ByVal db As DAO.Database, _
                           ByVal id As Long, ByVal needId As Long, _
                           ByVal catId As Long, ByVal fy As Integer, _
                           ByVal Hours As Double)
    db.Execute "INSERT INTO tblClientServicePlan (ClientServicePlanID, ClientServiceNeedID, " & _
               "ProviderServiceCatalogID, FiscalYear, HoursPerWeek) VALUES (" & _
               id & ", " & needId & ", " & catId & ", " & fy & ", " & Hours & ")", dbFailOnError
End Sub

Private Sub InsPlanCancelled(ByVal db As DAO.Database, _
                             ByVal id As Long, ByVal needId As Long, _
                             ByVal catId As Long, ByVal fy As Integer, _
                             ByVal Hours As Double)
    ' Requires the BeforeChange data macro on tblClientServicePlan to preserve
    ' an explicit Status="Cancelled" (see docs/uat-seed-design.md section 0).
    ' Without that fix, the macro will rewrite this row's Status to "Pending".
    db.Execute "INSERT INTO tblClientServicePlan (ClientServicePlanID, ClientServiceNeedID, " & _
               "ProviderServiceCatalogID, FiscalYear, HoursPerWeek, Status) VALUES (" & _
               id & ", " & needId & ", " & catId & ", " & fy & ", " & Hours & ", " & _
               SqlStr("Cancelled") & ")", dbFailOnError
End Sub

' --------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Phase 4 - Verification (counts + cancelled-status sanity check)
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub Verify(ByVal db As DAO.Database)
    Debug.Print "  Verification:"
    Debug.Print "    Services:           " & DCount("*", "tblServices") & " (expected 12)"
    Debug.Print "    Service rate limits: " & DCount("*", "tblServiceRateLimits") & " (expected 22)"
    Debug.Print "    Providers:           " & DCount("*", "tblProviders") & " (expected 6)"
    Debug.Print "    Catalog rows:       " & DCount("*", "tblProviderServiceCatalog") & " (expected 53)"
    Debug.Print "    Clients:            " & DCount("*", "tblClients") & " (expected 12)"
    Debug.Print "    Budgets:            " & DCount("*", "tblClientBudgets") & " (expected 21)"
    Debug.Print "    Needs:              " & DCount("*", "tblClientServiceNeeds") & " (expected 62)"
    Debug.Print "    Plans:              " & DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan") & " (expected 52)"

    Dim cancelled As Long, approved As Long, pending As Long
    cancelled = DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", "Status='Cancelled'")
    approved = DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", "Status='Approved'")
    pending = DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", "Status='Pending'")

    Debug.Print "    Plans Approved:     " & approved & " (expected 42)"
    Debug.Print "    Plans Pending:      " & pending & " (expected 9)"
    Debug.Print "    Plans Cancelled:    " & cancelled & " (expected 1)"

    If cancelled = 0 Then
        Debug.Print "    *** WARNING: 0 cancelled plans found, expected 1."
        Debug.Print "    *** The BeforeChange data macro on tblClientServicePlan likely"
        Debug.Print "    *** has not been patched to preserve Status='Cancelled'."
        Debug.Print "    *** See docs/uat-seed-design.md section 0 for the macro fix."
    End If
End Sub

' --------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Helpers
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------

Private Function SqlStr(ByVal s As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(s) Or Len(CStr(s)) = 0 Then
        SqlStr = "Null"
    Else
        SqlStr = "'" & Replace(CStr(s), "'", "''") & "'"
    End If
End Function

Private Function DateLit(ByVal d As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(d) Then
        DateLit = "Null"
    Else
        DateLit = "#" & Format(CDate(d), "yyyy-mm-dd") & "#"
    End If
End Function

Private Function TimeLit(ByVal t As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(t) Then
        TimeLit = "Null"
    Else
        TimeLit = "#" & Format(CDate(t), "hh:nn:ss") & "#"
    End If
End Function

Private Function BoolLit(ByVal b As Boolean) As String
    BoolLit = IIf(b, "True", "False")
End Function
